children: Saudi Arabia's non-oil private sector gains momentum in August, with the Riyad Bank Saudi Arabia Purchasing Managers' Index rising to 53.8 from 53.1 in July, its highest level in six months, S&P Global says. Output growth accelerated and hiring strengthened as domestic demand remained resilient, while supply conditions improved. Export demand remained comparatively weak, however, indicating that the expansion continues to be driven largely by domestic activity. (farhan.rafid@wsj.com)
